shape: free things that are still the best things

slides.text: the parts of sharing a life that cost nothing
taking your side in the hallway before hearing what the argument was even about.
leaving the [[better pillow]] on your side of the mattress, seven nights a week.
plugging your phone into the wall by the lamp, because you fell asleep on the rug.
three words mouthed across a crowded kitchen: [[let's go home]].
walking back two blocks in the rain to get the car, so you can wait under the dry shop awning.
pulling the duvet back over your shoulder at [[four in the morning]], without waking up enough to remember doing it.
save this for a quiet sunday evening, to remember how much of it is free.

caption:
we spend so much time worrying about the rent and the groceries.
my partner still leaves the warm crust of the loaf for me at breakfast.
the best parts of building a home never show up on a receipt.
save this for a long week when you forget why you share a kitchen with someone.
